assets.name: icon-atlas
assets.prompt: Create one production UI icon sprite atlas image, square 1:1, exactly 6 columns and 6 rows of equal square cells, no gutters, grid fills entire image. EXACTLY 36 distinct crisp simple azure blue #0072bc flat solid icons on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, one icon perfectly centered in each cell, each uses central 50% of cell with large clear padding, consistent stroke and size. No text, labels, boxes, borders, grid lines, shadows, backgrounds or decorations. Read left to right per row: ROW1 arrow right, arrow left, arrow up, chevron down, diagonal arrow up-right, checkmark. ROW2 hamburger menu 3 horizontal lines, X close, pause 2 bars, play triangle, magnifying glass, quotation mark pair. ROW3 two people, microchip, linked workflow modules, code angle brackets, telephone handset, globe. ROW4 database cylinder, graduation cap, hospital cross, shopping bag, smartphone, video camera. ROW5 map pin, network nodes, server rack, package cube, lightning bolt, shield. ROW6 office building, hotel bed, scan corners, radio broadcast signal, stacked layers, envelope. These are action and technology icons for a real website, must be recognizable at 24 pixels, clean precise silhouettes, no 3D material for this atlas.
